title: Equilibrium Numbers in Non-Square Bimatrix Games
summary: Bimatrix games may have an exponential number of mixed Nash equilibria if both dimensions of the game are allowed to grow. Bounds on their maximal number give structural insights that have been used to construct hard-to-solve games. We show new sharp or asymptotically sharp bounds on the (polynomial) number of equilibria for generic games where one dimension of the game is fixed and the number of strategies of the other player grows.
